title: Forge Workbench Approval Work List
description: Read-only, paged projection of the current employee's native approval items: pending items the employee can decide and returned items the employee originally submitted and has not resubmitted. Forge derives it from the native ApprovalsService and action history; it stores nothing and is not a second to-do system. Clients opt in with includeSubmitted=1 to also read their own pending sales-order submissions, separately from actionable approvals; this projection stores no new state.

requestId.description: Internal reference for follow-up calls; never displayed.

returnReason.description: Latest revise comment; present only for revision items.

nextCursor.description: Absent when the list is complete.
